description: Major update introducing playlist functionality, NSFW filtration, dedicated info pages, and significant UI/UX overhauls across the platform.

logs.desc: Playlist functionality for the Video Player. Users can now navigate between episodes using the next/previous arrows in the top-left corner.
NSFW filtration system for Anime, Movie, Webtoon, and Manga albums.
Total duration display for albums (cumulative length of all episodes). Currently requires a few seconds for initial calculation.
Dedicated Info Pages. Clicking a cover art now opens a detailed information view instead of starting playback immediately. Playback can be initiated via the 'Play' button from Episode 1.
TypeScript-based Language Handler. Turkish support is live, with more languages planned for future updates.
Forum link integration into the navigation bar.
Dynamic content loading for the Featured page. NSFW content is now automatically filtered based on 18+ age restrictions or explicit tags.
New TypeScript core modules: playerControls, videoPlayer, svgScripts, languageHandler, animeListerScript, sloganHandler, infoHandler, and playListHandler.
animeIDs.json to the /public directory for centralized ID management.
A new standardized structure and design for version history and logging.
Dynamic fetching for version logs to ensure real-time updates.
Store, What's New, and Forums links added to the footer.
Global Search Bar integrated into the primary navigation bar.
Resolved animation stuttering issues on the loading screen.
Modernized video player sliders for a sleeker look and feel.
Redesigned Hero sections for Featured, Settings, and Landing pages.
UI/UX overhaul of the Store page.
Updated Navbar behavior; it now transitions to a bottom-docked layout on smaller screens for better mobile accessibility.
Relocated the Language Switcher from the navigation bar to the footer.
Updated Side Navbar state; it is now collapsed by default to maximize content area.
Refined Dark Mode background color to true black (#000000).
Restructured /src/assets/animes/ directory for better asset management.
Refactored more UI elements into modular Astro components.
Comprehensive UI/UX update for the Footer.
Renamed 'Discover' to 'Featured' (algorithmically curated content). The new 'Discover' page now serves as a high-performance filtering engine for advanced content searching.
Deprecated content wrappers to streamline the DOM structure.
Store, What's New, and Forums links from the main navigation bar.
videoIds.json from the /public directory.
Context-aware Sidebar: Implemented a dynamic sidebar that changes based on the active page. (Note: Currently in demo/unstable state).
